concepts.gloss_en: Torah and prayer (the paired practice/means of separating good from evil)
words/utterances of Torah and prayer — the spoken dibburim, not the practice of Torah-and-prayer itself

members.note: representative; construct head 'דבורי' (speech/words of) makes this a distinct concept — the dibbur through which the body is nullified, per rule 4 (X about a thing ≠ the thing)

notes: Distinct construct heads: 'תורה ותפלה' names the paired practice; 'דבורי תורה ותפלה' names the speech-acts of Torah and prayer (context in lm1:75: speaking until the body is nullified and unites with the dibbur). Not identity — kept separate per rule 4.
